messages:
Maria K: heads-up — saw a sharp token/sec drop (~40%) after the canary rollout. queueing pattern is weird: bursty then long drains. smells like a kernel affinity misroute + KV churn. https://grafana.company/r/abc123 :warning:
Sam L: which model/variant and region? can you paste the timeline/queries?
Maria K: model=rdx-large-fp16@v2.3.2-canary, region=us-west-2. timeline snippet below.
Maria K: ```
# token/sec (1m rolling)
sum(rate(inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (node)
# p95 drain latency spike ~2026-03-17T14:02:30
```
Jihoon: checked node logs — gpu-34 had a bunch of kernel fallbacks around that timestamp. prefetch hint flip could force a memcopy path. grabbing kernel selection logs now.
Nora: we also see KV cache eviction rate spike for that model (~+400/s). if batches shrink, more unique prefixes -> higher eviction churn.
Maria K: perf trace (condensed):
Maria K: ```
TRACE: batch_ctor: avg_size=2.1 -> 0.9
SCHED: enqueue_wait p95 120ms -> 1.2s
KERNEL: selected copy_path=fast_memcpy_v2 fallback=memcpy_dma
KV: eviction_rate +430/s
```
Dan P: that avg batch drop is huge. v2.3.2 had the scheduler heuristic tweak (adaptive_prefetch=false) in the rollout. might be related.
Sam L: suggestion: bisect scheduler change (PR #4821) on canary, and diff kernel_profiles.json between stable and canary.
perf-ci-bot: perf-ci: nightly regression alert for rdx-large-fp16@canary — token/sec -38% (p=0.007). queued bisect job jobs/98347.
Jihoon: quick kernel-profile diff shows seq_len=128 mapping changed: matmul_optimized -> matmul_copy_path on ~25% of nodes. that would increase memcopy and delay batching.
Maria K: can someone run coordinator trace to get batching window timestamps (when batches were closed)? I'll open a temporary revert if bisect confirms.
Nora: starting a canary revert branch now and will trigger redeploy.
Dan P: added a temporary routing rule to send rdx-large-fp16 canary traffic to pool 'legacy-copy' to avoid the new kernel path. monitoring token/sec.
Maria K: quick update — after routing to legacy-copy pool token/sec recovered ~+30% within 5m. looks consistent with kernel affinity + KV churn combo.
Sam L: follow-ups: 1) root-cause the kernel selection change (profile thresholds), 2) add a KV-eviction guard when batch collapse detected, 3) add a small-batch backoff in scheduler to avoid preemption loop.
Maria K: thanks — filing the incident and linking PRs. cc: @oncall. :thumbsup:
notes: thread documents should be short and conversational; this one includes logs, commands, and a perf-ci bot message.
